jobs.title: Senior Structures Design Engineer, Launch Vehicle Structures (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Mission Brief  As part of the structural design team, you will be responsible for the design and development of the primary and secondary structures of the Spectrum launch vehicle. You will be involved in the assessment of existing and new design concepts and provide technical guidance to other design engineers, while developing critical systems yourself.    Your Role in Our Space Mission:  Design and develop composite and metallic structures for the Spectrum launch vehicle    Be responsible for the development of critical primary structures, respective interfaces and adjacent secondary structures.    Create CAD models, manufacturing and integration drawings including BOM.   Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams (Analysis, Production, Assembly & Integration, Testing, Quality, Avionics etc) to deliver robust, innovative, and optimized structural solutions that meet project requirements and high-quality standards to derive a fully qualified product.    Provide general guidance for structural development    Define and establish design standards, best practices and design documentation.   Review designs and manufacturing drawings of the structures team.    Prepare detailed road maps for the development of the products and maintain their related timelines up to date.   Host weekly meetings with the affected stakeholders to ensure the efficient development of the product.   Prepare design reviews, risk assessments, trade-off studies etc.   Provide an agile answer to production and assembly Non-Conformities.   Definition of necessary Requirements and Engineering Change Requests.   Company focal point for external suppliers.   Mentor and provide technical guidance for design challenges in the team. Qualification Checklist&

jobs.title: Manager Design - Product Design - HF
jobs.description: Les meilleurs designers ne sont pas toujours ceux qui dessinent le mieux. Ce sont ceux qui posent les bonnes questions avant d’ouvrir Figma. Ceux qui défendent un choix avec des arguments utilisateurs et business, pas esthétiques. Chez Hubvisory, on veut une équipe Design qui pense comme ça, et on cherche la personne qui va la faire grandir. Ta mission. Tu as un double rôle. Tu interviens toi-même en mission chez un de nos clients grands comptes, où tu portes l’expertise Design au plus haut niveau. En parallèle, tu manages une équipe de 6 à 8 Product Designers : leur progression, leur staffing, la qualité de leurs missions. C’est parce que tu restes sur le terrain que ton management est crédible. Tes responsabilités clés Montrer la voie en mission : tu es toi-même en mission chez un client, sur des sujets à fort enjeu. Tu y démontres ce qu’on attend d’un designer Hubvisory, et tu transmets cette exigence à ton équipe. Faire grandir tes designers : suivi individuel, feedbacks réguliers, plans de progression. Tu les aides à passer d’exécutants UI à consultants qui cadrent des problèmes, mènent la recherche et pèsent sur les décisions produit. Piloter le staffing : tu travailles main dans la main avec l’équipe commerciale pour qualifier les besoins clients, positionner le bon profil sur la bonne mission et anticiper les fins de mission. Faire du Design augmenté par l’IA une réalité : tu intègres l’IA dans ta pratique et dans celle de ton équipe, de la synthèse de recherche au prototypage. Tu sais aussi concevoir des expériences où l’IA est au cœur du produit. Porter l’exigence Design chez Hubvisory : tu contribues à structurer nos pratiques (User Research, discovery, design systems) et tu participes au recrutement de tes futurs designers. Notre objectif : faire de toi un Manager reconnu, capable de construire une équipe Design qui fait la différence chez nos clients. La suite se dessine selon ton impact. Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory : Des clients qui exigent du niveau

jobs.description: Your mission About L1VE L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment. Your Role As Designer, you shape how L1VE looks and how people experience it, from the first ad to the ticket purchase on our website. Our website is at the heart of the role: you design user journeys and pages that convert. You also create our event banners, flyers, ads and social assets. You take full ownership of design, build it up from the start and keep it lean, flexible and fast. You work closely with our Social Media Manager, our Content & Experience team and Product & Tech, and report to the Head of Marketing & Sales. Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin What You'll Do Design and continuously improve our website, from first visit to ticket purchase, and make it instantly clear what L1VE is: a real live broadcast you experience with a VR headset Map and optimize user journeys; create wireframes, prototypes and final designs in Figma Design for conversion: identify drop-offs, develop hypotheses and test page and flow variants based on analytics data Hand over developer-ready, responsive designs and build a clear design system with reusable components Design landing pages, key visuals and asset packages for our live events (banners, flyers, posters, on-site materials) and for email campaigns Create paid ads for social and display (static and simple motion) in all required formats, with variations for A/B testing Follow the design guidelines of our license partners precisely, keep our brand consistent, and brief external freelancers or agencies when more capacity is needed Use AI tools for ideation, image creation, variations and resizing; L1VE provides the AI tools you need Your profile Must-have 3–5 years of experience as a designer w

You ll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women s and men s health conditions. We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries. We re looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally. We hope that s you. You re a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact. Create designs that build trust and hold up in a regulated market. What good looks like Scope: you own a problem area end to end. jobs.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI. We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work. We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it. CodePath's educational programs run on our learning platform, a set of applications with functionality spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting. jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Family Experience
jobs.description: A Place for Mom is building the future of senior care, and design is central to how families, caregivers, providers, and APFM teams navigate that experience. We are looking for a Staff Product Designer to own product design for Consumer Experience and help us turn emotionally complex care decisions into clear, trustworthy, high-quality product experiences. APFM is organizing around the two customers that define our marketplace: families navigating care decisions and providers delivering care. Evolving toward a more connected experience across the full care placement journey. This role is for someone who is curious about where product design is going, not only where it has been. We do not expect anyone to have ten years of experience with tools that are only beginning to emerge. We do expect you to be actively experimenting with AI tools, learning where they help, where they fail, and how they can create leverage without replacing judgment, craft, accessibility, ethics, or deep user understanding. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing, Analytics, Operations, Sales, and business leaders to shape consumer journeys that help families understand their options, build confidence, and take the next best step in a high-stakes senior care decision. Who you are: You are a high-agency builder: someone who moves toward ambiguity, takes ownership without waiting for perfect direction, and uses design, data, and AI-native tools to make the team move faster and raise the quality of the work. You care about users, business outcomes, product quality, and team momentum. You have strong design judgment, but you are not precious about process. You know when to prototype, when to simplify, when to push for a better system pattern, and when to help the team make a pragmatic decision. You are AI-forward without being AI-naive. jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior UX Designer at SkinVision As a Senior UX Designer, you will be responsible for designing and refining intuitive, engaging, and effective user experiences across SkinVision’s digital products. You will conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our platform provides the best possible user experience. Your work will directly contribute to making early skin cancer detection accessible and user-friendly. Your impact Enhance User Experience: Design seamless, user-friendly interfaces that encourage engagement and retention. jobs.title: Edge AI & Computer Vision Intern
jobs.description: We are investigating real-time edge computing architectures to enhance visual feedback in next-generation medical robotics. Our systems combine high-bandwidth video streams with real-time robotic telemetry to support precision tasks. In this internship, you will lead the hands-on prototyping of an edge AI processing unit using a state-of-the-art Edge AI development platform. You will be responsible for bringing up the hardware from scratch, establishing a low-latency video pass-through pipeline, and evaluating how computer vision and machine learning models can extract insights and render helpful visual cues in real time. Tasks : • Hardware Bring-Up: Set up, configure, and benchmark a new edge AI development platform (operating system, drivers, hardware acceleration libraries, and high-speed video capture interfaces). • Low-Latency Video Pipeline: Explore and prototype low-latency video streaming architectures using real-time processing frameworks to capture high-resolution camera feeds and drive responsive external displays. • Telemetry & Visual Overlays: Ingest robotic telemetry alongside the video feed to render dynamic graphical annotations and spatial guidance cues directly onto the live stream. • Computer Vision & AI Prototyping: Benchmark lightweight computer vision algorithms and modern neural network architectures (e.g., for object tracking, state awareness, or semantic scene understanding) on edge hardware. • System Profiling & Documentation: Measure end-to-end processing delays, evaluate hardware resource utilization, and document the architecture to guide future product development.
